messages.text: Hi B, I reviewed the proposed values [10, 12] against the limit of 11. The value 10 is acceptable, but 12 exceeds the limit, so the requirement that every proposed value be <= 11 is violated. Please reject the mock change and note the defect: 12 > 11. We cannot approve any real change. Do you agree to reject?
Agree. [10, 12] violates the requirement because 12 > 11, so not every proposed value is <= 11. Reject the mock change and record the defect as 12 exceeding limit 11. No real change can be approved.

task.requirement: Every proposed value must be <= limit.
